race.comment: ANGEL UNDERCOVER (4) ran on well from off the speed first-up to be 1.2L off the winner in a strong return. Out to this trip now looks ideal and Parnham hops on now. She has a good second-up record and a firmer deck this time suits. Ticks plenty of boxes and can go one better in the feature. CAPTAIN PLUTO (1) goes well fresh and comes in with two trials under his belt, signalling the stable's intent. Pike hasn't ridden him in the trials, but he's booked for his return and he is a track and trip winner. Likely to be back in the field but can storm over the top on resumption. SENSESSIONAL (2) ended last campaign in hot form and looks to be in similar order judging by his latest trial. A good draw is a big tick and CJP sticking from the trials is a big push for his chances. Can make an impact. TRIPLE JAY (3) has looked good at the trials and Brad Parnham has won 4/6 when aboard. He appeals. SILVER EYE (6) can resume on a positive note.
